How to upload your ride to Strava & co.
Upload your ride to Strava & co.

1. Export this ride as GPX with the button above.

2. Save the GPX file or send it straight to another app (Drive, Files, e-mail, …).

3. Sign in on the provider’s website (Strava, Komoot, Garmin Connect or RideWithGPS) and choose the GPX file under “Upload activity” / “Import”.

Note: the Strava and Komoot mobile apps often can’t import GPX directly, so uploading on the website is the reliable route.
